column1: # lrn-y50-k50-ins (q 0.99) had no endogenous withdrawals in any episode, so it could not
# show learning under a backstop. These arms put insured and uninsured depositors in one
# bank: q = the deposit quantile the insurance covers (0.5: up to the median deposit).
# Each coverage level has its own no-learning control; all arms common-seeded with
# arms/learning_l2.tsv. Under Rule A the θ weights equal k50's by construction (Rule A
# is outcome-blind); what to read is whether endogenous withdrawals survive at each q
# (the gate for the Rule B / L3a coverage arms) and P(fail) and the gap against q 0.
